# GraphScene's near level draws nodes as marks, names the ones in focus, and crossfades in

## Context

The operator on the Observatory, 2026-11-05: *"the max zoom out level for observatory feels fine. zooming in is not enough though. you could explore apps/covid inside the engine repo => MapBox GL. … after zooming in up to a specific level, items get rendered differently. the same could in theory happen for our agent os graph. i am open minded: after all, we are dealing with around 100k nodes."*

The design read already exists. Clio's zoom ladder (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#312, comment 6222093228, 2026-10-16) has three levels: L0 sky, L1 field, and L2 street, crossfaded between. She ordered it (a) zoom range plus `near` band, (b) the label layer plus fly-to, (c) the morph.
- (b) shipped: #20286, PR #20288.
- (a)'s range and band ship with neomjs/neo-agent-institution#839 (`zoom.min` 0.1, `near` 0.35, as Observatory config).
- What remains is the part the operator describes, nodes rendered differently past a zoom threshold. That part is engine mechanics.

## The Problem

Below `near`, GraphScene draws the same thing as above it, only bigger:
- **No mark floor.** `gl_PointSize = aSize * uScale / max(vDepth, 0.1)` (`src/canvas/GraphScene.mjs:25`) divides by `vDepth`, the depth relative to the camera distance, which is 1 at the orbit target. So a node there draws at its uploaded size at every zoom. A dense Observatory read's node is 0.4 units. `uScale` is the drawing buffer's shorter side over 400, so on an 800 CSS px surface that is 0.8 CSS px at any pixel ratio. No zoom makes it a readable mark; zooming in only spreads the nodes apart. Clio's target is ≥ 6 px at L2. (Corrected 11-05: this line first claimed the node grows to 4 px at the deepest zoom.)
- **No names for what's in focus.** The label layer (#20286) packs a FIXED label set into one atlas at upload (`uploadLabels` / `packLabels`). The Observatory labels its wells. Naming the nodes nearest the orbit target means a per-frame label set over the whole scene, which a once-packed atlas cannot hold for 100k nodes (2048² limit).
- **No transition.** Levels switch at a threshold (`getLodLevel`, `:574-588`), so a level change pops.

## The Architectural Reality

- **The precedent is `apps/covid/view/mapboxGl/Component.mjs:30-82`.** A heatmap carries density up to zoom 5 and fades out 5→6 (`heatmap-opacity` interpolated on `zoom`). Per-item circles fade in 5→6, and their count labels 5→7. Aggregate becomes individual, with opacity ramps across the threshold rather than a switch. MapBox is not used here; the pattern is.
- **GraphScene already has the levels and the distance:** `lod` thresholds as config (`:101-106`), `getLodLevel()` from `camera.dist / fittedDistance`, a label layer with `labelStyle.max` (30, Clio's "≤ 30 labels on screen") and collision placement (`placeLabels`), and per-node `positions`/`sizes` on the scene.
- **The scene owns the names.** `scene.labels` today carries `{nodes, texts, sizes}` for a fixed set. A fovea set needs a text for any node the camera can approach, given once with the scene and rasterized on demand.

## The Fix

At the `near` level and below, as engine config the app sets:
1. **A mark floor.** A uniform minimum point size applies past the `near` threshold, ramped across it rather than switched (`lodStyle.near.minPointSize`, or the shape the implementer finds cleaner). The app sets the value; the Observatory starts at Clio's 6–8 px.
2. **Fovea labels.** Each frame names up to `labelStyle.max` of the nodes nearest the orbit target that pass `placeLabels`' gap and on-surface checks, from a per-node text source on the scene. Glyphs rasterize on demand into the atlas, which evicts the least recently drawn. `packLabels`' two invariants stay: a label never claims more than the atlas holds, and never hides the point it names. A scene without the text source behaves as today.
3. **A crossfade.** Mark size and label opacity interpolate across the `near` threshold over a configurable band (the covid ramps' shape), so crossing the level reads as a morph, not a pop.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: A unit arm shows a node's drawn size at or above the floor below `near`, untouched above it, and a monotonic ramp across the band, red on `dev` first.
- [ ] AC-2: A unit arm over a 100k-node fixture scene: at the near level the frame names at most `labelStyle.max` nodes, the ones nearest the target that pass placement, and none of them hides its point (the `lift` invariant). Moving the target changes the set, and memory stays bounded by the atlas (eviction observed).
- [ ] AC-3: A unit arm shows label opacity ramping from 0 at the band's outer edge to 1 at its inner edge.
- [ ] AC-4: A scene without the per-node text source draws exactly as today (the fixed `scene.labels` path unchanged).

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] The Observatory consumer, neomjs/neo-agent-institution#878, shows BEFORE/AFTER frames at the deepest zoom on a ≥ 20k-node read, read by the design seat or the operator before its PR. This was AC-5. It moved here on 11-05 because the consumer is its own leaf, and this engine ticket cannot deliver it.

## Out of Scope

- Zoom toward the pointer, the keyboard zoom, double-click fly-to, and the canvas hover halo: Clio's other L2 motions. Each is its own leaf when wanted.
- Any 3D beyond the orbit. Clio's read keeps the orbit and goes no further.
- MapBox or any map library.
